title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-05
source: Matrix of SBD(96540) and AUD(94260) with ALT AUD(88559) and PATCH AUD(9768)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix mix delivers a superb‑sounding 1971 show highlighted by a stellar That's It suite and tight Other One.
ai_review.review: The matrix soundboard/audience blend is praised as balanced, clear and far superior to a straight soundboard, giving listeners an immersive live feel. The performance itself is lauded for its strong 1971 vibe – especially the That’s It suite and a complete Other One – though one reviewer notes that “Not Fade Away” and “Bird Song” are missing from the source material.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for both performance and matrix recording, but a single 0‑star comment about missing tracks drags the overall average down; weighted rating reflects strong show and recording quality with some completeness issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced mix, superb live sound, clear and immersive. Reviewers call it “far superior to just a soundboard” and “magnificent”. One note mentions that both audience and board copies omit Not Fade Away and Bird Song.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow highlighted by a cohesive That's It suite and a complete Other One, giving the show an energetic 1971 feel.
